name: jengo/queues
description: Asynchronous job queue and worker management subsystem supporting Redis, Database, Sync, and Null drivers with automatic retry backoff, failed job handling, and test fakes.

contracts.name: Jengo\Queues\Contracts\ShouldQueue
contracts.description: Marker interface indicating that a job class should be dispatched to an asynchronous queue.

contracts.name: Jengo\Queues\Contracts\JobInterface
contracts.description: Contract for encapsulated worker jobs providing methods like fire(), delete(), release($delay), attempts(), and fail($exception).

contracts.name: Jengo\Queues\Contracts\QueueDriverInterface
contracts.description: Queue driver implementation contract with push(), later(), pop(), size(), clear(), and status().

contracts.name: Jengo\Queues\Contracts\FailedJobProviderInterface
contracts.description: Interface for storing and querying failed job logs.

traits.name: Jengo\Queues\Traits\Queueable
traits.description: Provides fluent job configuration methods: onQueue(string), onConnection(string), delay(int), tries(int), timeout(int), backoff(int), and dispatch().

traits.name: Jengo\Queues\Traits\InteractsWithQueue
traits.description: Allows job instances to interact with the underlying job runner: delete(), release($delay), attempts(), and setJob($job).

facades_and_helpers.description: Helper to push a job immediately to the default queue.
Helper to push a job to the default queue with a delay in seconds.
Helper to access the QueueManager or a specific queue driver instance.

cli_commands.description: Runs the worker daemon continuously processing jobs from queues.
Listens for and processes jobs synchronously.
Inspects, retries, deletes, or flushes failed jobs.
Purges all pending jobs from a queue.
Checks connectivity, driver health, and pending job count.

testing.name: Queue::fake()
testing.description: Swaps active drivers with an in-memory test fake supporting assertPushed(), assertPushedTimes(), assertPushedOn(), assertNotPushed(), and assertNothingPushed().
